_generic._done: Lovely work. That is your routine complete.
_generic._tingle: No problem. We will skip that one and move on.

chin_tucks.setup: Sit or stand tall and glide your chin straight back, making a gentle double chin.
tips: Keep your eyes level; the head slides back, it does not tip down.
Hold each tuck briefly, then relax forward and repeat.
Feel a light stretch at the base of the skull.
Breathe easily and keep your shoulders soft and low.

neck_flexion.setup: Sit tall, let your chin drop toward your chest, and rest a hand lightly behind your head.
tips: Let the weight of your hand do the work; never pull.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling into the arms or legs.
Feel the stretch along the back of your neck and upper back.
Breathe slowly into your upper back and let your shoulders soften.

neck_extension.setup: Sit tall and slowly tilt your head back to look up at the ceiling.
tips: Lead with your eyes and keep the movement small and comfortable.
Hold lightly, return to level, and repeat at an easy pace.
If you feel any dizziness, bring your head back to level.
Breathe softly and keep your shoulders relaxed and down.

ear_to_shoulder.setup: Sit tall and let your ear tilt gently toward your shoulder, face looking forward.
tips: Keep the opposite shoulder heavy, drawing it down away from your ear.
Feel the stretch along the side of your neck.
Breathe out slowly and let the neck soften a little further.
No hand pressure needed; let gravity do the gentle work.

neck_rotation.setup: Sit tall and slowly turn your head to look over your shoulder.
tips: Keep your chin level, turning the nose rather than tipping the head.
Let your shoulders stay square and still while only the head turns.
Breathe out and see if the turn eases a touch further.
Stay in a comfortable range; there is no need to strain.

upper_trap_stretch.setup: Sit tall, tuck one hand behind your back, and tilt your ear away from that arm.
tips: Let the shoulder of the tucked arm draw gently down toward the floor.
Feel the stretch run from your neck to the top of your shoulder.
For a little more, rest your free hand lightly on your head.
Breathe slowly and let your jaw and face relax.

levator_scapulae_stretch.setup: Sit tall, turn your nose down toward your armpit, and rest a hand lightly on the back of your head.
tips: Let the hand rest lightly; its weight is enough, never pull.
Feel it at the back of your neck, down toward the shoulder blade.
Keep the opposite shoulder heavy and drawn down.
Breathe out slowly and let the neck soften.

scalene_stretch.setup: Sit tall, lift your chin slightly and turn your head a little to the side.
tips: Feel a gentle stretch along the front and side of your neck.
Rest a hand on your collarbone to keep it anchored down.
Keep it subtle; ease off if anything feels pinchy or dizzy.
Breathe slowly through your nose and let your jaw soften.

shoulder_rolls.setup: Stand tall, arms relaxed, and roll your shoulders in slow, full circles.
tips: Lift up toward your ears, squeeze back, then let them drop down.
Make each circle as big and smooth as feels comfortable.
Every few circles, reverse the direction.
Breathe in as you lift, breathe out as you let them fall.

cross_body_shoulder.setup: Bring one arm across your chest and hold it just above the elbow with your other hand.
tips: Keep the shoulder down and away from your ear.
Feel the stretch across the back of the shoulder.
Draw the arm in gently; avoid pressing on the elbow joint itself.
Breathe out and let the shoulder blade widen and soften.

eagle_arms.setup: Cross one arm under the other in front of you, wrap the forearms, and lift your elbows.
tips: Lift the elbows to shoulder height and ease them slightly forward.
Feel the space widen between your shoulder blades.
If your palms cannot meet, press the backs of the hands together.
Keep your shoulders low and breathe wide into your upper back.

cow_face_arms.setup: Reach one hand over your shoulder down your back, and the other up behind to meet it.
tips: If the hands do not meet, hold a towel or strap between them.
Keep your ribs soft and avoid arching your lower back.
Feel the stretch along the back of the top arm and the shoulder.
Breathe slowly, keeping your head tall and your elbow pointing up.

reverse_prayer.setup: Bring your palms together behind your back, fingertips pointing up between your shoulder blades.
tips: If palms will not meet, hold opposite elbows behind your back instead.
Roll the shoulders back and open the chest.
Feel the stretch across the fronts of the shoulders and wrists.
Breathe steadily and keep your wrists comfortable; ease off if they ache.

doorway_pec.setup: Rest your forearm on a doorframe, elbow bent to ninety degrees at shoulder height, and step gently through.
tips: Keep your shoulder down and back, not rolling forward.
Feel the stretch open across your chest and the front of the shoulder.
Ease off if you feel tingling or pinching in the arm.
Breathe into your chest and let it open a little more each exhale.

sleeper_stretch.setup: Lie on your side, bottom elbow bent to ninety degrees at shoulder height, and ease that hand toward the floor.
tips: Use your top hand to press gently; never force the rotation.
Roll slightly back off the shoulder if you feel any pinching.
Feel the stretch at the back of the shoulder.
Rest your head on a cushion and breathe slowly.

wall_slides.setup: Stand with your back to a wall, arms bent to ninety degrees, and slowly slide them up overhead.
tips: Keep your lower back gently against the wall; do not arch.
Slide up as you exhale, then down as you inhale.
Only go as high as you can while keeping contact.
Draw the shoulder blades down as the arms come back down.

thread_needle.setup: On hands and knees, slide one arm under your chest, across to the far side, and rest that shoulder down.
tips: Keep your hips stacked over your knees as you twist.
Feel it open between your shoulder blades and behind the shoulder.
Breathe into your upper back and let the twist deepen naturally.
Rest your head fully and let your neck relax.

child_pose_extended.setup: Kneel, sit back toward your heels, and fold forward, walking both hands far out in front.
tips: Press lightly through your palms and feel your arms and sides lengthen.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Breathe slowly into your back and let your forehead rest heavy.
Widen your knees or place a cushion under your hips if needed.

pendulum_swings.setup: Rest one hand on a table, hinge forward with soft knees, and let your other arm hang loosely.
tips: Let the arm swing in small, slow circles, driven by your body sway.
Keep your back long, and ease off at any tingling down the leg.
Breathe easily and keep the hanging arm loose, like a heavy rope.
Every few circles, reverse the direction.

cat_cow.setup: Come onto hands and knees, wrists under shoulders, and slowly alternate arching and rounding your back.
tips: Move slowly: inhale as your belly drops and chest lifts, exhale to round.
Round up through the whole spine, letting your head hang heavy.
Keep the range easy; ease off at any tingling down the leg.
Let the breath set the pace, one smooth wave at a time.

thoracic_extension_chair.setup: Sit on a chair and gently lean back over the chair-back, reaching both arms overhead.
tips: Let the bend come from your upper back, not your lower back.
Support your head with your hands if your neck feels strained.
Feel your chest open and the upper spine gently extend.
Breathe deeply into the front of your chest.

open_book.setup: Lie on your side, knees bent and stacked, arms out in front, and open your top arm across.
tips: Keep your knees together and resting down as your chest turns open.
Follow your moving hand with your eyes to turn the upper spine.
Breathe out as you open, letting the arm settle toward the floor.
Only go as far as feels easy; the arm need not touch down.

quadruped_tspine_rotation.setup: On hands and knees, place one hand behind your head and rotate that elbow up toward the ceiling.
tips: Then sweep the elbow down and under toward the supporting arm.
Keep your hips still and level; the turn comes from your upper back.
Inhale as you open up, exhale as you thread under.
Move slowly and smoothly, never swinging into the end range.

wall_angels.setup: Stand with your back flat to a wall, arms bent at ninety degrees, and trace slow snow-angel arcs overhead.
tips: Keep head, upper back and lower back gently touching the wall.
Exhale as the arms rise, inhale as they lower.
Only go as high as you can while keeping your arms in contact.
Feel the muscles between your shoulder blades doing the work.

bear_hug.setup: Wrap your arms around yourself, hands reaching toward your shoulder blades, and round your upper back.
tips: Breathe wide into your back and feel the shoulder blades spread apart.
Keep the curve high; ease off at any tingling down the leg.
Let your chin drop slightly and your neck soften.
Let your shoulders drop away from your ears as you breathe out.

doorway_pec_high.setup: Rest your forearm on a doorframe with the elbow above shoulder height, and step gently through.
tips: Keep your shoulder down and back, away from your ear.
Feel the stretch across the chest and toward the armpit.
Ease off if you feel tingling or pinching in the arm.
Breathe slowly and let your chest open a little more each exhale.

doorway_pec_low.setup: Rest your forearm on a doorframe with the elbow below shoulder height, and step gently through.
tips: Keep your chest tall and the shoulder from rolling forward.
Feel the stretch across the front of the shoulder and upper chest.
Ease off if you feel tingling or pinching in the arm.
Breathe slowly and let your weight carry you gently forward.

corner_stretch.setup: Face a corner, place a forearm on each wall at shoulder height, and step gently in.
tips: Keep your chin tucked and avoid poking your head forward.
Feel both sides of your chest open evenly.
Keep a gentle brace through your middle so the lower back stays neutral.
Breathe slowly into your chest and let your shoulders settle back.

floor_y_hold.setup: Lie face down, arms overhead in a Y, thumbs up, and lift your arms just off the floor.
tips: Draw your shoulder blades down and back, away from your ears.
Keep your forehead resting lightly, with your neck long.
Feel the muscles between and below your shoulder blades working.
Breathe steadily; lower and rest if you need, then lift again.

reclined_butterfly.setup: Lie back, soles of the feet together, knees falling open, arms resting overhead.
tips: Support each knee with a cushion if your hips feel strained.
Let your lower back rest naturally, without pressing or arching.
Feel your inner thighs and chest gently open.
Breathe slowly into your belly and let your whole body grow heavy.

childs_pose.setup: Kneel, sit back toward your heels, and fold forward, arms ahead or resting by your sides.
tips: Let your forehead rest down and your whole back grow heavy.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Breathe slowly into your lower back and feel it widen.
Widen your knees or place a cushion under your hips for comfort.

knee_to_chest.setup: Lie on your back and draw one knee toward your chest, hands holding behind the thigh.
tips: Keep the other leg bent with the foot flat, or long if comfortable.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Feel a gentle stretch in your lower back and buttock.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the mat as you breathe.

cobra.setup: Lie face down, hands under your shoulders, and press your chest up, keeping your hips on the floor.
tips: Only rise as high as is comfortable; elbows can stay softly bent.
If symptoms spread further down the leg, lower down and ease off.
Let your buttocks and lower back stay relaxed rather than clenched.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears and breathe slowly.

sphinx.setup: Lie face down and prop yourself up on your forearms, elbows under your shoulders.
tips: Let your belly and hips sink heavy into the floor.
If symptoms spread further down the leg, lower down and ease off.
Gently draw your chest forward and keep your neck long.
Breathe slowly and let your lower back soften into the gentle curve.

supine_spinal_twist.setup: Lie on your back, arms out wide, bring your knees up and lower them gently to one side.
tips: Keep both shoulders heavy on the mat as the knees settle.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Only lower as far as feels easy; rest the knees on a cushion.
Breathe out slowly and feel the twist soften through your lower back.

bird_dog.setup: On hands and knees, reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back, then alternate slowly.
tips: Keep your hips level, as if balancing a cup on your lower back.
Reach long rather than high; the leg stops at hip height.
Exhale as you extend, inhale as you return to all fours.
Move slowly and keep your neck long, gaze down at the mat.

glute_bridge.setup: Lie on your back, knees bent and feet flat, then press through your heels to lift your hips.
tips: Squeeze your glutes to lift; avoid arching through your lower back.
Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower slowly down.
Rise until knees, hips and shoulders form a straight line.
Feel the work in your buttocks, not your hamstrings or lower back.

mckenzie_press_ups.setup: Lie face down, hands beside your ribs, and press your chest up while your hips stay down.
tips: Let your lower back and buttocks stay completely relaxed as you rise.
Press up as you exhale, lower slowly as you inhale.
If symptoms spread further down the leg, keep the range smaller.
Rise a little higher each time, only as far as feels easy.

superman_hold.setup: Lie face down, arms reaching forward, and lift your arms, chest and legs just off the floor.
tips: Keep the lift small; length matters more than height.
If your back or leg complains, lift only the arms and chest.
Keep your gaze down so your neck stays long.
Breathe steadily through each hold, then lower and rest before repeating.

kneeling_hip_flexor.setup: Come into half-kneeling, back knee on a cushion, then squeeze the back-leg glute and shift forward.
tips: Tuck your pelvis under first; the stretch comes from the tuck.
Feel it at the front of the hip on the kneeling side.
Stay tall through your chest and avoid arching your lower back.
Breathe out and let the front of the hip soften a little more.

couch_stretch.setup: Kneel with your back foot up on a couch, front foot planted, and gently drive your hips forward.
tips: Squeeze the back glute and tuck your pelvis; keep your ribs down.
Stay leaning forward on the front thigh if upright feels too strong.
Feel a deep stretch along the front of the thigh and hip.
Breathe slowly; this one is intense, so stay well below any strain.

pigeon_pose.setup: Bring one shin forward across your mat, extend the other leg straight back, and fold gently forward.
tips: Keep your hips square, with a cushion under the front hip if needed.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Feel the stretch deep in the buttock of the front leg.
Rest on your forearms or a cushion and breathe slowly into the hip.

half_pigeon_supine.setup: Lie on your back, cross one ankle over the opposite knee, and draw that thigh gently toward you.
tips: Flex the crossed foot to keep the knee comfortable.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Feel the stretch deep in the buttock and outer hip.
Keep your head and shoulders resting heavy on the mat as you breathe.

frog_stretch.setup: Come onto all fours, widen your knees, turn your toes out, and rest on your forearms.
tips: Keep your ankles in line with your knees, shins parallel.
Sit your hips back slowly, only as far as feels easy.
Feel the stretch along your inner thighs and groin.
Breathe out and let your hips sink a little heavier.

butterfly_stretch.setup: Sit tall, bring the soles of your feet together, and let your knees fall open.
tips: Lengthen up through your spine before any gentle lean forward.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Rest your elbows lightly on your knees, with soft, gentle pressure.
Breathe slowly and let your knees soften toward the floor.

ninety_ninety.setup: Sit with your front leg bent at ninety degrees ahead, back leg bent ninety degrees beside you.
tips: Sit tall and square your chest over your front shin.
Feel it deep in the outer hip and seat of the front leg.
Use your hands behind you for support if your hips feel tight.
Breathe out and let the front hip settle a little lower.

lizard_pose.setup: Step into a low lunge, back knee down, and lower both forearms inside your front foot.
tips: Keep your front knee tracking over your ankle, not collapsing inward.
Feel the stretch in your front inner hip and back hip flexor.
Stay on your hands instead if forearms feel too deep.
Breathe slowly and let your hips sink gently with each exhale.

reclined_figure4.setup: Lie on your back, cross your ankle over the opposite knee, and pull the thigh in gently.
tips: Flex your crossed foot to protect the knee, and keep shoulders heavy.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Feel it deep in the seat of the crossed leg.
Breathe out and let the crossed knee drift gently away from you.

deep_squat_hold.setup: Stand with feet a little wider than hips, toes turned out, and sink into a deep squat.
tips: Keep your heels down; rest them on a folded towel if needed.
Only sink as deep as your lower back stays comfortable.
Press your elbows gently against your inner knees to open the hips.
Breathe slowly into your belly and let your hips settle.

single_leg_glute_bridge.setup: Lie on your back, plant one foot, extend the other leg, and lift your hips.
tips: Drive through your planted heel and squeeze your glute at the top.
Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower slowly.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Keep your hips level; do not let them tip or twist.

clamshells.setup: Lie on your side, knees bent, feet together, and slowly open the top knee.
tips: Keep your feet touching and your hips stacked; do not roll back.
Exhale as the knee opens, inhale as it lowers.
Feel it working in the side of your seat.
Small and controlled beats big and rushed.

fire_hydrants.setup: On all fours, keep your knee bent and lift it out to the side.
tips: Keep your back flat and your weight even across both hands.
Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower with control.
Lift only as high as your hips stay level.
Feel the work in the side of your seat.

side_lying_hip_abduction.setup: Lie on your side, bottom knee bent for support, and slowly lift your straight top leg.
tips: Lead with your heel and keep your toes pointing forward.
Exhale to lift, inhale to lower slowly.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Keep your hips stacked; lift only as high as stays controlled.

donkey_kicks.setup: On all fours, keep your knee bent and press the sole of your foot toward the ceiling.
tips: Keep your lower back still; the lift comes from your seat.
Exhale to press up, inhale to lower with control.
Lift only to hip height, never arching to go higher.
Keep your neck long and your gaze down between your hands.

standing_forward_fold.setup: Stand with feet hip width, soften your knees, and fold forward from your hips.
tips: Keep your knees softly bent and let your arms hang heavy.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Let your head and neck relax completely, nodding gently if you like.
Breathe into your back and let it soften with each exhale.

seated_forward_fold.setup: Sit with legs straight in front, knees soft, and hinge forward toward your toes.
tips: Lead with your chest and keep your spine long, not rounded.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Bend your knees as much as you need; never force the reach.
Breathe slowly and let your hamstrings soften with each exhale.

supine_hamstring_strap.setup: Lie on your back, loop a strap over one foot, and raise that leg toward you.
tips: Keep the knee soft and the foot relaxed.
Stop before any tingling; ease off at the first hint.
Keep your other leg and your hips resting heavy on the mat.
Breathe slowly, holding the strap lightly, with shoulders relaxed.

wide_leg_forward_fold.setup: Sit with legs wide and straight, sit tall, then fold forward from your hips.
tips: Keep your back long; lead with your chest, not your head.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Keep knees and toes pointing up, and soften the knees if needed.
Breathe out and let your inner thighs and hamstrings soften.

single_leg_forward_fold.setup: Sit with one leg straight, the other foot tucked to your inner thigh, and fold forward.
tips: Hinge from your hips over the straight leg, keeping your spine long.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Soften the knee of the straight leg if the stretch feels sharp.
Breathe slowly and let your shoulders and neck relax.

standing_hamstring_chair.setup: Stand facing a chair, rest one heel on the seat, and hinge forward from your hips.
tips: Keep your back long and the raised knee softly unlocked.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Keep your standing knee soft and a hand near support.
Breathe out and let the back of the thigh soften.

down_dog.setup: From all fours, tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back.
tips: Bend your knees freely so your spine stays long.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Press the floor away and let your head hang between your arms.
Breathe slowly; let your heels drift toward the floor without forcing.

toe_to_wall.setup: Place your toes up against a wall, heel down, and hinge gently forward from your hips.
tips: Keep the leg straight but the knee unlocked.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Feel the stretch through your calf and back of the leg.
Breathe easily and keep a hand on the wall for support.

standing_quad.setup: Stand tall, hold a support, and draw one heel toward your seat by the ankle.
tips: Knees together, pelvis gently tucked, standing tall.
Keep a hand near support so you stay steady.
Feel the stretch along the front of the thigh.
Breathe easily, without arching your lower back.

side_lying_quad.setup: Lie on your side, bend your top knee, and hold that ankle behind you.
tips: Draw the heel gently toward your seat, keeping knees together.
Tuck your pelvis slightly so your lower back stays long.
Feel it along the front of the top thigh.
Rest your head on your arm and breathe easily.

kneeling_quad.setup: Kneel facing away from a wall, back shin up against it, front foot forward in a lunge.
tips: Squeeze your back glute and tuck your pelvis gently under.
Sink your hips only as far as stays comfortable.
Breathe slowly and let the front of the thigh soften.
Pad the back knee and keep a hand near support.

hero_pose.setup: Kneel with knees together and sit back onto your heels, or onto a block.
tips: Use a block or cushion if your knees or ankles complain.
Sit tall, stacking your shoulders over your hips.
Feel a gentle stretch across the fronts of your thighs and ankles.
Rest your hands on your thighs and breathe slowly.

standing_calf.setup: Hands on the wall, step one leg back, keep it straight, and press the heel down.
tips: Keep your back toes pointing straight forward.
Lean your hips gently toward the wall to deepen it.
Feel it in the upper calf of the straight leg.
Breathe easily and keep your shoulders relaxed.

bent_knee_calf.setup: Hands on the wall, step one leg back, heel down, and gently bend the back knee.
tips: Keep the back heel grounded as the knee bends.
Feel it lower down, deep in the calf near the ankle.
Keep your toes pointing forward and hips square.
Breathe slowly and let the calf soften.

down_dog_pedal.setup: From all fours, lift your hips into down dog, then press one heel down, then the other.
tips: Bend one knee as the other heel sinks, like walking in place.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Breathe steadily and keep the rhythm slow and smooth.
Keep your neck relaxed and your head between your arms.

heel_drops.setup: Stand on a step on the balls of your feet, hold a rail, and slowly lower your heels.
tips: Lower your heels slowly below the step; never bounce.
Keep a hand near support the whole time.
Rise back up smoothly, keeping your knees soft.
Breathe steadily and feel the calves lengthen and work.

ankle_circles.setup: Lift one foot, holding a support, and draw slow circles with your toes.
tips: Keep the movement in the ankle, with your leg still.
Make the circles as big and smooth as feels easy.
Keep a hand near support to stay steady.
Reverse direction halfway and breathe easily throughout.

forearm_plank.setup: Lie face down, then rise onto your forearms and toes, body in one straight line.
tips: Elbows under shoulders, and squeeze your glutes to protect your lower back.
Draw your belly gently in; do not let your hips sag.
Breathe steadily; never hold your breath.
Drop to your knees anytime the line starts to break.

knee_plank.setup: Lie face down, then rise onto your forearms and knees, body in one line.
tips: Keep a straight line from your head through to your knees.
Elbows under shoulders, belly drawn gently in.
Squeeze your glutes so your lower back stays neutral.
Breathe steadily and keep your neck long.

dead_bug.setup: Lie on your back, arms up, knees over hips, then slowly lower opposite arm and leg.
tips: Keep your lower back gently pressed into the mat throughout.
Exhale as you lower, inhale as you return to centre.
Move slowly; only lower as far as your back stays flat.
Keep your neck relaxed and your head resting on the mat.

hollow_body_hold.setup: Lie on your back, press your lower back down, and lift your arms and legs slightly.
tips: Keep your lower back pinned to the floor the whole time.
Bend your knees or raise your legs higher to make it easier.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Keep breathing steadily; never hold your breath.

hollow_body_rocks.setup: Find your hollow body shape, lower back down, then rock gently forward and back.
tips: Keep the shape fixed; the rock comes from your whole body.
Small, smooth rocks are plenty; stay in control.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Breathe steadily with the rhythm, never holding your breath.

toe_taps.setup: Lie on your back, knees bent at ninety degrees, then lower one toe to tap the floor.
tips: Alternate slowly, keeping your lower back gently pressed into the mat.
Exhale as the toe lowers, inhale as it returns.
Keep the knee bend fixed; move only from the hip.
Keep your neck and shoulders relaxed on the floor.

leg_lowers.setup: Lie on your back, legs up toward the ceiling, and slowly lower them toward the floor.
tips: Only lower as far as your lower back stays pressed down.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Exhale as you lower, inhale as you lift back up.
Soften your knees or place hands under your hips for support.

v_sit_hold.setup: Sit tall, lean back slightly, and lift your legs, balancing in a V with arms forward.
tips: Keep your chest lifted and spine long rather than slumped.
Bend your knees to make the balance easier.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Breathe steadily and keep a hand near the floor if needed.

side_plank.setup: Lie on your side, prop up on your forearm, and lift your hips into a straight line.
tips: Stack your elbow directly under your shoulder.
Keep your hips lifted and in line with your head and feet.
Breathe steadily; never hold your breath.
Drop the bottom knee anytime you need an easier version.

side_plank_knees.setup: Lie on your side, knees bent, prop up on your forearm, and lift your hips.
tips: Elbow under shoulder, body straight from head to knees.
Press the bottom knee down and lift through the side waist.
Breathe steadily and keep your top shoulder rolled back.
Keep your neck long, gaze straight ahead.

side_bend.setup: Stand tall, feet hip width, reach one arm overhead, and bend gently to the opposite side.
tips: Keep both feet grounded and your hips steady.
Lean straight sideways, not forward or back.
Feel the stretch along the whole lengthened side of your body.
Breathe into your ribs and let them open with each inhale.

standing_oblique_reach.setup: Stand tall, reach one arm up overhead, and lengthen that whole side of your body.
tips: Reach up first, then only a gentle arc over.
Keep your shoulders relaxed away from your ears.
Feel it from your hip all the way to your fingertips.
Breathe in to grow taller, breathe out to soften.

pallof_press.setup: Stand side on to the anchor, band at your chest, and press your hands straight out.
tips: Resist the twist; keep your chest and hips facing forward.
Brace your belly gently and keep your knees soft.
Exhale as you press out, inhale as you draw back in.
Move slowly, pausing briefly with your arms fully extended.

reverse_plank.setup: Sit with legs straight, hands behind you, fingers forward, and lift your hips into a straight line.
tips: Press through your hands and heels, squeezing your glutes to stay up.
Keep your neck neutral rather than dropping your head back.
Bend your knees to tabletop if the straight line feels too much.
Breathe steadily; never hold your breath.

quadruped_opp_raise.setup: On all fours, slowly reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back, then alternate.
tips: Keep your back flat and hips level, as if balancing a cup.
Lift only a few inches; control matters more than height.
Exhale as you reach, inhale as you return to all fours.
Keep your neck long, gaze down between your hands.

prone_ytw.setup: Lie face down, forehead resting on a folded towel, arms reaching overhead in a Y shape.
tips: Lift your arms only an inch or two, leading with your shoulder blades.
Move slowly from Y, to T, to W, pausing briefly in each.
Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.
Keep your neck long and your gaze down towards the mat.

sun_salute.setup: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart. Sweep both arms overhead, then hinge forward with soft knees.
tips: Inhale to sweep up, exhale to fold. Let the breath set the pace.
Keep your knees generously bent as you fold, so the back stays easy.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Rise slowly, rolling up through the spine, head coming up last.

bodyweight_squat.setup: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Lower slowly for three, pause for two, rise for three.
tips: Sit your hips back as if reaching for a chair behind you.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes and your chest lifted.
Inhale on the way down, exhale as you stand.
Only go as deep as feels comfortable for your back.

goblet_squat_hold.setup: Hold a weight close to your chest, feet a little wider than hips, and sink into a deep squat.
tips: Keep your chest tall and the weight tucked in close to you.
Press your knees gently outwards, in line with your toes.
Breathe slowly into your belly and let your hips settle lower.
Rise up a little if your low back starts to round.

forward_lunge.setup: Stand tall, then step one foot forward and lower the back knee gently towards the floor.
tips: Keep your front knee over your ankle, not drifting past your toes.
Push through the front heel to step back up to standing.
Exhale as you push back up; move at a steady, even pace.
Keep your torso upright and your core gently engaged.

reverse_lunge.setup: Stand tall, then step one foot back and lower that back knee gently towards the floor.
tips: Keep most of your weight in the front heel.
Front knee stays over the ankle; hips square to the front.
Inhale to step back, exhale to drive up to standing.
Shorten the step if anything pulls in your low back or leg.

lateral_lunge.setup: Stand with feet together. Step one foot wide to the side and sit your hips back over it.
tips: Keep the other leg straight and both feet pointing forward.
Sit back into the hip, chest proud, rather than leaning forward.
Ease off at any tingling down the straight leg.
Exhale as you push off to return to the centre.

worlds_greatest_stretch.setup: Step into a long lunge, hands inside your front foot, then open your top arm to the ceiling.
tips: Follow your top hand with your eyes, rotating through your upper back.
Then shift your hips back, front knee soft, for a gentle hamstring reach.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Exhale into each rotation; move slowly, three rounds, no rushing.

cossack_squat.setup: Take a wide stance, toes turned out slightly, and shift your weight low over one leg.
tips: Keep the heel of the bent leg down and your chest lifted.
Move slowly side to side, only as low as feels easy.
Ease off at any tingling down the straight leg.
Exhale as you sink, inhale as you travel through the middle.

down_dog_flow.setup: Start in downward dog, hands wide and knees soft, then flow slowly forward to plank and upward dog.
tips: Exhale back to downward dog, inhale forward through plank to upward dog.
Keep your knees bent in downward dog so the hamstrings stay easy.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
In upward dog, lift gently, shoulders away from your ears.

single_leg_balance.setup: Stand tall beside a wall or chair, then lift one foot just off the floor.
tips: Keep a hand near your support, ready to steady yourself.
Soften the standing knee and spread your weight through the whole foot.
Breathe slowly and fix your gaze on one still point ahead.
If steady, try closing your eyes for a few breaths.

tree_pose.setup: Stand near a support, then place the sole of one foot on your inner calf or thigh.
tips: Keep a hand near your support until you feel steady.
Press foot and leg gently into each other, avoiding the knee joint.
When steady, raise your arms overhead, shoulders soft.
Breathe slowly and rest your gaze on one still point.

heel_toe_walk.setup: Walk slowly in a straight line, placing each heel directly in front of the other toes.
tips: Walk alongside a wall so a hand can stay near support.
Fix your gaze ahead rather than down at your feet.
Move slowly and smoothly, one calm step per breath.
Arms can float out to the sides to help you balance.

sit_to_stand_practice.setup: Sit cross-legged on the floor, then stand up without using your hands or knees.
tips: Lean forward over your feet and drive up through your legs.
Lower back down slowly and with control, then repeat.
Exhale as you rise; take a breath between each rep.
Use a hand for support whenever you need it; no straining.

single_leg_deadlift.setup: Stand on one leg near a support, then hinge at the hip as the other leg reaches back.
tips: Keep a hand near your support, ready to steady yourself.
Keep your back long and hips level, standing knee softly bent.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Inhale as you hinge, exhale to squeeze the glute and stand.

eyes_closed_romberg.setup: Stand beside a wall with feet together and arms by your sides, then gently close your eyes.
tips: Keep a hand near the wall, ready to steady yourself.
Let small sways happen; stay soft rather than rigid.
Breathe slowly and evenly through your nose.
Open your eyes at any time if you feel unsteady.

pilates_hundred.setup: Lie on your back, knees in tabletop, lift head and shoulders, and pump straight arms by your hips.
tips: Inhale for five pumps, exhale for five pumps.
Keep your low back gently anchored to the mat.
Rest your head down if your neck tires; keep the arms pumping.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.

pilates_roll_up.setup: Lie on your back, knees softly bent, arms overhead, then roll up slowly into a forward fold.
tips: Peel up one vertebra at a time, then roll down the same way.
Inhale to lift arms and head, exhale to curl up and over.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Keep your knees bent if the fold pulls; no momentum needed.

pilates_double_leg_stretch.setup: Lie on your back, curl head and shoulders up, and hug your knees into your chest.
tips: Inhale to reach arms and legs out long, exhale to circle back in.
Keep your low back anchored; reach the legs higher if it lifts.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Let your gaze rest towards your knees, neck long.

pilates_single_leg_stretch.setup: Lie on your back, head and shoulders curled up, one knee hugged in, the other leg extended.
tips: Alternate legs smoothly, drawing one knee in as the other reaches away.
Exhale with each change; keep a steady, even rhythm.
Keep your torso still and your low back anchored to the mat.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.

pilates_criss_cross.setup: Lie on your back, hands behind your head, curl up and bring one elbow towards the opposite knee.
tips: Twist from your ribs, not your elbows; keep the elbows wide.
Exhale as you twist, inhale as you pass through the centre.
Hands cradle the head lightly; never pull on your neck.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.

pilates_teaser.setup: Sit with knees bent, lean back, then lift your legs and reach your hands towards your toes in a V.
tips: Keep your knees bent and shins level for an easier version.
Lift through your chest; avoid slumping into your low back.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Breathe steadily rather than holding your breath.

pilates_roll_over.setup: Lie on your back, arms by your sides, legs straight up, then roll your hips over behind you.
tips: Only roll as far as is easy; never let weight onto your neck.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Press your arms down and lower one vertebra at a time.
Exhale to roll over, inhale as you lower slowly.

pilates_saw.setup: Sit tall with legs wide and arms out to the sides, then twist and reach towards the opposite foot.
tips: Reach your little finger past the outside of the foot, like a saw.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Bend your knees slightly or sit on a cushion to keep things easy.
Exhale to twist and reach, inhale to rise back up tall.

pilates_spine_stretch.setup: Sit tall with legs wide and straight, arms reaching forward, then round forward one vertebra at a time.
tips: Soften your knees or sit on a cushion so the hamstrings stay easy.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Exhale as you curl forward, inhale to stack back up tall.
Think of lifting up and over, rather than collapsing down.

pilates_swimming.setup: Lie face down, arms reaching forward, then lift your arms, legs and chest just off the mat.
tips: Flutter opposite arm and leg in small, quick, controlled movements.
Keep your neck long and your gaze down towards the mat.
Breathe in for five flutters, out for five.
Keep the lift low; lower down if your back complains.

pilates_side_kick.setup: Lie on your side, head resting on your arm, and lift the top leg to hip height.
tips: Swing the top leg forward and back, slow and controlled.
Keep your hips stacked and your torso still.
Keep the forward kick small; ease off at any tingling down the leg.
Exhale as the leg swings forward, inhale as it sweeps back.

pilates_mermaid.setup: Sit on one hip, legs folded beside you, and reach the opposite arm up and over your head.
tips: Lengthen up through your waist before you bend; think up and over.
Feel the stretch open along your side, from hip to fingertips.
Breathe into your ribs, letting each exhale soften the stretch.
Keep both sit bones heavy; use a cushion under your hip if needed.

pilates_open_leg_rocker.setup: Balance on your sit bones holding your ankles, legs in a V, then rock back to your shoulders.
tips: Keep a rounded spine and roll smoothly, never onto your neck.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Bend your knees, holding behind them, if straight legs pull.
Inhale to rock back, exhale to return to balance.

pilates_leg_circles.setup: Lie on your back, one leg reaching up to the ceiling, the other bent with foot flat.
tips: Trace small, slow circles with the raised leg, keeping your pelvis still.
Soften the raised knee; it does not need to be straight.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Breathe steadily; reverse the circle direction halfway through.

pilates_bridge.setup: Lie on your back, knees bent and feet hip-width, then peel your spine up one vertebra at a time.
tips: Exhale to curl up, inhale at the top, exhale to roll down.
Lift only to a straight line from knees to shoulders, no higher.
Feel your glutes and hamstrings working, not your low back.
Lower slowly, placing each part of your spine down in turn.

knees_to_chest_rock.setup: Lie on your back, hug both knees into your chest, and rock gently side to side.
tips: Keep the rock small and slow, massaging your low back into the mat.
Let your head stay heavy, and breathe slowly into your low back.
Hold behind your thighs if that feels kinder to your back.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.

sciatic_nerve_slider.setup: Sit tall on a chair. Straighten the knee and look up; bend the knee and look down.
tips: A glide, never a pull. Keep the movement smooth and easy.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Breathe in as the knee straightens, out as it bends.
Stay tall through your spine and let your shoulders relax.

sciatic_slider_gentle.setup: Sit tall with your head still and level. Straighten the knee only halfway, then bend it back.
tips: Small, easy range. This is a gentle glide, never a stretch.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Keep your head neutral and your gaze softly ahead.
Breathe slowly and let the movement stay smooth and unhurried.

supine_hamstring_towel.setup: Lie on your back, loop a towel around one foot, and raise that leg gently.
tips: Knee soft, foot relaxed. Stop before any tingling down the leg.
Breathe slowly; a mild stretch in the back of the thigh is plenty.
Keep the other knee bent with that foot flat for your back.
Hold the towel lightly; shoulders stay heavy on the mat.

supine_9090_hamstring.setup: Lie on your back and hold one thigh upright behind the knee, knee bent at a right angle.
tips: Ease the shin up only a little, keeping the knee bent.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
A gentle stretch behind the thigh is enough; no tension down the leg.
Breathe slowly and keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the mat.

figure4_wall.setup: Lie back with your feet on a wall, knees bent, and cross one ankle over the other knee.
tips: Let the crossed knee fall gently away. Let gravity do it.
Breathe into the outer hip and let it soften with each exhale.
No pulling. Shuffle closer to the wall only for more stretch.
Flex the top foot lightly to protect the knee.

childs_pose_supported.setup: Kneel with knees wide, place a pillow under your chest, and fold forward to rest on it.
tips: Breathe into your low back and feel it widen with each inhale.
Let your whole upper body feel heavy on the pillow.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.
Add a cushion between hips and heels if your knees feel tight.

leg_swings.setup: Stand side-on to a support, hold it with one hand, and swing the outside leg front to back.
tips: Keep a steady hand on your support and stand tall.
Swing like a pendulum, breathing easily with a smooth rhythm.
Start small and let the range grow naturally; never force it.
Ease off at the first hint of tingling down the leg.

standing_back_extension.setup: Stand tall, hands on your low back, ease your hips forward and lean back gently.
tips: Lean back only a little, then return upright. Five slow repeats.
Exhale as you lean back, inhale as you come up tall.
Keep your knees soft and your neck long; look ahead, not up.
Stop if anything pinches or sends sensation down the leg.

standing_hip_flexor.setup: Take a split stance. Squeeze the back-leg glute, tuck the pelvis, and shift gently forward.
tips: Feel the stretch across the front of the back hip.
Keep your tuck as you shift; avoid arching your low back.
Breathe slowly and let the front of the hip soften.
Hold a support nearby if your balance wobbles.
